name: Can I convert an existing garage into an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert an existing garage into an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting an existing attached garage into an ADU is a common and often more cost-effective option than new construction. This process typically involves insulating walls and ceilings, upgrading electrical and plumbing systems, adding a kitchen and bathroom, and ensuring adequate ventilation and natural light. It also requires compliance with all ADU regulations, including ceiling height requirements and fire separation. A garage conversion often leverages existing foundations and roofs, reducing material and labor costs compared to ground-up construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, converting an attached garage into an ADU is common, involving insulation, utility upgrades, and adding a kitchen/bathroom, often being more cost-effective than new construction.
